newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish Intercontinental buys Norwich Union firms.
newsitem.headline: Irish Intercontinental buys Norwich Union firms.

text.p: Irish Intercontinental Bank (IIB) said on Thursday it had doubled its presence in the British market with the acquisition of a number of businesses from Norwich Union.
"IIB's new acquisitions have a combined value of 225 million stg and increase the bank's involvement in the provision of asset finance to 450 million stg in the UK," IIB said in a statement.
Irish-based IIB is 75-percent owned by Belgium's Kredietbank and 25-percent owned by assurance firm Irish Life.

"These acquisitions from Norwich Union fit with IIB's defined UK strategy of concentrating on high quality corporate finance asset finance transactions and commercial property finance," IIB Chief Executive Ted Marah said in a statement.
"Our policy is to continue our expansion in the UK through organic growth and acquisition," he said.
